author: krzfred219
title: WHAT IS HAPPENING?!
content:
This app used to be one of my favorites. It used to be that ads only popped up between games. Then, the ads started popping up in the middle of the game, when one of the numbers had been completely used correctly. The ads started popping up more frequently, but still only when it did not affect strategy or focus. A while back, the ads began interrupting play at random points in time, making it increasingly difficult to maintain focus on strategy. Now, out of nowhere, the ads are popping up all the time. Even worse, if you try to click on the “x” or other option to exit the ad, it immediately takes you to the ads’ website; often multiple times for the same ad. This makes it necessary to close the browser and get back into the game, but back into the same ad, which takes you back to its website again, repeat, repeat, repeat, ad infinitum. I understand that ads are the way this game remains free for the user, but this has gotten way out of control!!! 
Now you know why my rating is only one star!

author: Is this Dawn taken?
title: Inconsistent score for tournaments and postcard challenges
content:
I’ve played this Sudoku game for a few years and consistently score well in tournaments. But something’s off between the tournament scoring and the postcard challenge rankings.

The latest tournament and the postcard challenge both started yesterday. Since then, I’ve played almost exclusively the postcard challenge and I’m leading the tournament scoreboard, with the next closest player at a little over a third of my score. The postcard challenge has three parts: 16 games, then 25, then 64, for 105 games total. I’ve finished the first two postcards and one game into the third, so 42 games. But someone has already completed all three, all 105 games, since yesterday. That’s 63 more games than me, in the same one day. But, as I said, I am leading the tournament—by almost a million points.

So either someone got a huge head start, they’re getting much easier puzzles, or we’re not all playing the same version of this event. Regardless, it’s frustrating and distracting.

title: Fun but has a frustrating bug
content:
Lots of variations in the different games. Sometimes my fat finger hits the wrong square or the wrong number, but that’s on me! I’m also a little rattled by the percentage of people who complete a given game, hoping that won’t be me, but so far I’ve gotten through all but one. 

The thing that bothers me is every now and then you complete a square or a row and it gives you praise, like genius or good work, and then it throws you right out of the game! You have to exit, come back in, click on continue, and then remember where you were at. That’s really challenging when you were saying to yourself, this is a one and that’s a five, and then you get thrown out out of the game after the one and have to remember when you get all the way back in where the five was. I don’t really know why you get thrown out of the game every time it praises you; that seems like a real bug.
